reaction.episode: DIGESTION episode, data through Oct 26 and not stale: SPX 7676.77 is 2.14% below its 120-day high, 0.27% below its 50-day and 5.23% above its 200-day; SMH 541.62 sits in Zone 1 (540-565) while NVDA 216 sits above its Zone 1 band; VIX 18.39 and HY OAS 3.23 are calm, and the mechanical capitulation tally is 2 of 4 (zone occupancy and credit calm confirmed; no volume climax reversal, no VIX rollover).
reaction.invalidation: A held SPX close above 7750-7820 with SMH above 600 voids the Watch stance and the trap framing; conversely, HY OAS above 4% or VIX above 25 voids the calm-digestion framing and replaces it with a regime-break stance.

ladder.response: Stage Tranche A (25%): begin the Zone 2 probe per the deployment ladder, sized as a probe — not a full position — until confirmation
ladder.trigger: SMH closes into Zone 2 (470-505) with the mechanical tally at 3 of 4 or better

ladder.response: Trap case: do not chase the bounce; treat the rejection as confirmation of the pivot-and-fail and wait for the Zone 2 verdict instead of adding into strength
ladder.trigger: SPX or SMH bounces into the failure zone (SPX 7750-7820 / SMH 580-600) but fails to hold a close above it

ladder.response: Stand down: pause all probe/add activity, keep new money in bills, and re-audit the ladder zones before any further action
ladder.trigger: HY OAS above 4% or VIX above 25, or SMH closes below the Zone 1 floor (540) on expanding volume

ladder.response: Re-entry condition met: digestion ends, the failure-zone trap is voided, and the posture upgrades from Watch to staged Add on the confirmed side
ladder.trigger: Held SPX close above 7750-7820 with SMH holding above 600

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail scenario is the live risk: SMH has only marginally re-entered Zone 1 and the tape is bouncing into the FOMC, so the first bounce is the least trustworthy entry. Entries wait for either the failure-zone verdict (a held close above 7750-7820 / SMH 600) or the Zone 2 washout (SMH 470-505) — never the middle of the bounce.

strategyPosture: Watch. The digestion episode is intact, the mechanical tally is only 2 of 4, and the FOMC decision lands tomorrow — no tranche trigger has fired (SMH is in Zone 1, not Zone 2), so the portfolio holds its posture and lets the failure-zone verdict come to it.

themes.counterRead: The rollover narrative runs ahead of what credit and index data support: a leadership rotation punishes the heaviest-weighted names while the broad index holds near its highs. Treating Mag7 weakness as systemic break risks selling a rotation. The read flips only if credit cracks — SLOOS rising toward stress or HY OAS breaking out — so the rotation thesis is conditional, not complacent.
themes.dataAnchor: The Mag7 average sits 12.54% below its 52-week highs against SPY only 1.6% below its high, a 10.94-point divergence gap, yet bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 0%, far below the ~40% stress threshold) and HY OAS is calm at 3.23. SPY itself is up 0.55% on the midday tape at 769.57 with QQQ up 1.18% at 720.60, and the weakest Mag7 name is GOOGL at 21.2% below its high while AAPL holds just 1.8% below its high — a spread inside the leadership group, not uniform collapse.
themes.label: Index-leadership rotation, not a broad rollover
themes.narrative: The market reads the Mag7 drawdown as the start of a broad market break: the index leaders are falling hard, so the tape must be rolling over.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS breaking above 4% or SLOOS moving off 0% toward the ~40% stress zone would void the rotation read.

themes.counterRead: Price has fallen much further than the businesses have: these are sentiment-driven dislocations (AVGO, LRCX, ONTO, VRT all flagged SENTIMENT_DRIVEN with recovery-confirmed revenue inflections), not broken theses. That is the setup the opportunity board is built for — but dislocation alone is not an entry trigger, and the names stay gated by the episode ladder: Zone 1 occupancy is a watch condition, not a buy signal, with Zone 2 (SMH 470-505) as the ladder's next rung.
themes.dataAnchor: The dislocation list shows the opposite split. AVGO trades 30.9% below its high with revenue growing 55% YoY, a 67.8% gross margin and 42.1% FCF margin, and carries the top conviction score of 81 (tier A). LRCX is 45.1% below its high with revenue up 131.3% YoY, ONTO is 44.4% below its high with revenue up 22.1% YoY, and VRT is 44.7% below its high with revenue up 27.7% YoY. SMH itself sits in Zone 1 at 541.62, 19.38% below its 120-day high, while NVDA at 216 sits above its Zone 1 band (200-210) after a 2.39% bounce.
themes.label: AI semiconductor dislocation: fundamentals ahead of price
themes.narrative: The AI trade is broken: semiconductor names have fallen 30-50% from their highs, so the AI infrastructure story must be deteriorating with them.
themes.watchFor: SMH closing into Zone 2 (470-505) or holding above the 580-600 failure zone would change the entry posture.

themes.counterRead: Theme and price roughly agree that power scarcity is real, but the name-level data splits: VST has insider conviction against a deteriorating revenue inflection, and the smaller nuclear names are bouncing from deep holes, not breaking out. Position on VST's held thesis and insider signal, not on the one-day bounce in SMR/OKLO/ASTS.
themes.dataAnchor: The bounce is real but sits inside deep drawdowns: SMR is up 7.02% today yet down 28.7% over the month, OKLO is up 4.16% today yet down 27.19% over the month, and ASTS is up 6.08% today yet down 31.39% over the month. VST, the held name, is up 2.5% today and 5.26% over the month with insiders buying $1.17M at the trough, but its revenue inflection reads DETERIORATING — the only watchlist promotion with that flag — while its price sits 27.3% below its high.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power: bounce inside a drawdown, name quality split
themes.narrative: AI power demand makes nuclear the next leg of the trade, and today's sharp bounces confirm the theme is re-accelerating.
themes.watchFor: VST's revenue inflection flipping off DETERIORATING, or SMR/OKLO holding a weekly close above their recent bounce highs, would upgrade the theme.

themes.counterRead: Narrative and data agree this is a digestion, which is precisely why the FOMC print matters: a calm tape sitting below the SPX 7750-7820 failure zone has more room to trap a bounce than to confirm one. The constructive midday breadth is a relief bounce inside the digestion until a held close above the failure zone says otherwise; the CPI event from Oct 14 remains active in the signal set, so inflation data is still part of the tape's memory.
